summary.prose: Building this fix touches three layers. The CLI provider gets an opt-in silence watchdog for codex structured calls and a typed schema rejection; the review pipeline uses them with a 60 s silence limit, a 600 s cap, three attempts for stalls and accurate attempt counts, plus a bounded verify answer and a prompt that matches codex's grammar; and the daemon and step tool keep long reviews alive with a heartbeat and progress relay. It ends with a live codex check, one full test sweep and a daemon rollout confirmed on a real review.

tasks.title: Silence watchdog for opted-in structured codex calls
tasks.summary: Add stallMs to StructuredCompletionOpts; give ProcessGroupOpts.stall a silence mode that kills the group when no new stdout chunk arrives for stall.ms (reset on each chunk); the codex branch of completeStructured arms it when stallMs is set and below timeoutMs. Reviewer sessions keep the first-output mode; claude ignores stallMs.
acceptanceChecks: A structured codex call with stallMs kills a silent run and throws CliStallError
A run that prints an item event early then goes silent is killed stallMs after its last output
A run that keeps printing within stallMs completes
Without stallMs no watchdog is armed; reviewer sessions keep first-output behaviour

tests.name: a structured codex call with stallMs kills a run that prints no output and throws CliStallError
a structured codex call with stallMs kills a run that prints an item event and then goes silent, stallMs after its last output
a structured codex call that keeps printing within stallMs completes, and without stallMs no watchdog is armed
claude ignores stallMs and reviewer sessions keep the first-output watchdog

tasks.title: Typed schema rejection with reasons
tasks.summary: ModelResponseShapeError gains an optional reasons list; codexReply throws it with ValidationResult.errors when a codex answer fails the caller's schema; the review pipeline driver's classify returns those reasons with cause 'invalid-answer' and passes them to applyFailure.
acceptanceChecks: A codex reply that breaks the caller's schema throws ModelResponseShapeError with reasons
The pipeline classifies it as invalid-answer and the re-issued prompt carries the correction note when it fits
Existing ModelResponseShapeError throw sites are unchanged

tests.name: a codex reply that breaks the caller's schema throws ModelResponseShapeError carrying the validation reasons
a review call rejected by the reply check is classified invalid-answer and re-issued with a correction note carrying the reasons

tasks.title: Bound the verify answer and align the verify prompt
tasks.summary: Add the maxLength/maxItems bounds to VERIFY_SCHEMA (they reach VERDICTS_SCHEMA) and rewrite the SYSTEM fixability rules to ask for an always-present proposedFix with empty fields when there is no fix. Run the review and review-pipeline suites that import VERIFY_SCHEMA or VERDICTS_SCHEMA and update any schema snapshot they hold.
acceptanceChecks: VERIFY_SCHEMA and VERDICTS_SCHEMA carry the bounds and an over-long answer fails validation
SYSTEM no longer tells the model to omit fields and asks for empty fields when there is no fix
A no-fix answer normalises as before (no proposedFix with an empty rationale; rationale-only otherwise)
Suites that import VERIFY_SCHEMA or VERDICTS_SCHEMA pass

tests.name: VERIFY_SCHEMA and VERDICTS_SCHEMA bound evidence, action, rationale, edits and options, and an answer over a bound fails validation
the verify SYSTEM rules ask for an always-present proposedFix with empty fields when there is no fix and no longer tell the model to omit fields, in both the single and batched prompts
a no-fix answer with an empty rationale normalises to a finding without proposedFix, and one with a rationale keeps a rationale-only proposedFix

tasks.title: Stall retry budget and attempt counts in the review pipeline
tasks.summary: ExecutionMode's structured mode carries stallMs and the driver forwards it (building on t2's classify change in driver.ts); applyFailure re-issues a 'stall' failure while attempt < MAX_STALL_ATTEMPTS (3), other causes keep MAX_CALL_ATTEMPTS; NotJudged gains attempts and notJudgedFinding, ReviewCallFailedError and the applyFailure log report the real count.
acceptanceChecks: A stalling call is re-issued up to three times; an invalid answer only once
A claim exhausted after three attempts is reported as three attempts
An older NotJudged without attempts still renders
The driver forwards stallMs to completeStructured

tests.name: a review pipeline call that stalls is re-issued up to three times, while an invalid answer is re-issued only once
a claim whose three attempts stall, or two stalls then a transient failure, is recorded as not judged with a message naming three attempts
ReviewCallFailedError names the real attempt count and an older NotJudged without attempts still renders
the pipeline driver forwards a structured call's stallMs to completeStructured

tasks.title: Verify and extract calls use the stall limit and the 600 s cap
tasks.summary: Set VERIFY_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS to 600_000, add VERIFY_CALL_STALL_MS = 60_000, and pass both from verifyClaim and the design-review verify and extract stages; update the tests that pin the old 180 s value.
acceptanceChecks: Every design-review verify and extract call is sent with stallMs 60 s and timeoutMs 600 s
verifyClaim passes both
The pinned-limit tests assert the new values

tests.name: the design-review verify and extract stages send VERIFY_CALL_STALL_MS (60 s) and VERIFY_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS (600 s) with every call
verifyClaim passes VERIFY_CALL_STALL_MS and VERIFY_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS

tasks.title: Heartbeat frames from workflow.review
tasks.summary: workflowReviewStart sends a {kind:'heartbeat', operation:'workflow.review', elapsedMs} progress frame every WORKFLOW_REVIEW_HEARTBEAT_MS (60 s) while a review runs and stops before the terminal frame.
acceptanceChecks: Heartbeats arrive every 60 s during a review
No heartbeat after 'done' or 'error'
Stage frames are unchanged

tests.name: workflow.review sends a heartbeat frame every 60 s while a review runs and none after the terminal frame, and its stage frames are unchanged

tasks.title: insrc_review_step relays progress and waits with an idle limit
tasks.summary: ReviewStepDeps gains progress; the step host wires insrc_review_step with its progress callback; reviewByDaemon passes onFrame (relaying every frame) and idleMs = DESIGN_REVIEW_IDLE_MS (5 min) beside the existing ceilings; an idle timeout names the idle limit.
acceptanceChecks: Through step.call every daemon progress frame, heartbeats included, arrives as a 'progress' frame before 'done'
A healthy review longer than 15 minutes completes while heartbeats flow
No frame for 5 minutes fails with a daemon-review-timeout naming the idle limit

tests.name: insrc_review_step through step.call relays every daemon progress frame, heartbeats included, as a 'progress' frame before 'done'
a healthy design review longer than 15 minutes completes while heartbeats flow, and a daemon that sends no frame for 5 minutes fails with an idle timeout naming the idle limit

tasks.title: Live check, full sweep and daemon rollout
tasks.summary: Run the live codex check of the bounded VERIFY_SCHEMA, run the full test sweep once, rebuild and restart the installed daemon, and confirm on a real DEF review that progress reaches the controller and stalls are retried within about a minute.
acceptanceChecks: Live: codex accepts the bounded VERIFY_SCHEMA strict copy and a verified finding passes the reply check
Full sweep passes (pre-existing failures named)
A real DEF review relays progress and any stall is retried within about a minute

tests.name: codex accepts the strict copy of the bounded VERIFY_SCHEMA and a real verify call returns a finding that passes the reply check
a real DEF review on the rebuilt daemon relays progress to the controller and retries any stall within about a minute
